verdict: Lead volume is low this period; overdue milestones are the priority to unblock growth.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 7 leads at a cost of $238 per lead — volume is too thin right now to draw firm efficiency conclusions, but the number is below where it needs to be. The sharpest movement came in the last 7 days, when spend pulled back 45% and leads dropped 50% versus the prior 7 days, driven largely by a 67% reduction in Google Ads daily spend. Six milestones that were due between July 31 and September 1 — including confirming an intake owner, launching the Review Boost campaign, publishing the financing page, and enabling heating toggles on Local Service Ads — remain open, and clearing these is the direct path to scaling budget back up. This week the focus is on closing those overdue items so that the October heating campaign launch and budget re-raise can proceed on schedule.
